scripts.db:migrate: npx sequelize-cli db:migrate --config config/config.js --migrations-path migrations --models-path models
scripts.db:migrate:undo: npx sequelize-cli db:migrate:undo --config config/config.js --migrations-path migrations --models-path models
scripts.db:migrate:undo:all: npx sequelize-cli db:migrate:undo:all --config config/config.js --migrations-path migrations --models-path models
scripts.db:reset-data: npm run db:clear-data && npm run db:seed
